Title: General availability: Azure Arc-enabled servers in Azure China

Body.Content:
Azure Arc-enabled servers are now generally available in two Azure China regions:

  • China East 2
  • China North 2

With this announcement, Azure Arc-enabled servers are generally available available in 34 regions worldwide. For more information, see the Azure Arc-enabled servers documentation.
